_comment: The send queue a run in flight fills: a draft turns the send control into a question (hold it in the queue, or interrupt and send), and what is held waits above the box, readable, editable and removable, until the run ends. Every row here was produced by the composer's own menu against a run the harness streams, and every sentence is placeholder text — nothing on these screens comes from a real conversation.

send-queue-choice.note: A follow-up typed while the host is answering the previous prompt. The slot that was Stop now asks what this send means — `加入发送队列` (sent when the reply ends) or `打断后发送` (stop the reply and send now) — because the host takes one prompt at a time and a press that reached the wire could only come back as a refusal over a message the reader meant to send.

send-queue-local-interrupt.note: The interrupt, in the two frames that matter, from one real gesture on this machine's own conversation. `打断并全部发送` is pressed with one sentence held and another in the field: the first frame is the gap before the run is reported over — the reply still finishing, the queue still holding both sentences, nothing handed over yet — and the second is what actually left, one message carrying both in the order they were written, above the stopped reply. Cropped to the composer's column: no rail, no transcript above the turn.

send-queue-choice.note: The same question on the phone: a reply is running (`?streaming=1` reports the demo conversation as mid-run) and a follow-up is typed, so the send control opens a sheet instead of refusing the press — hold the message in the queue, or interrupt the run and send it now. The sheet is the phone's own surface: the desktop shows the same two rows in a popover above its send button.

steps.eval: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 12000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (document.querySelector('[aria-label="给 FutureOS 发消息"]')) return 'chat open'; const dismiss = [...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role=button]')].find(button => /以后再说|稍后再说/.test(button.textContent || '')); if (dismiss) { dismiss.click(); } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); } throw new Error('the conversation never opened'); })()

send-queue-refused-edit.note: What a queue looks like when the host would not take it, and the row being fixed. The reader interrupts with the queue waiting, the phone sends it as one message, the host refuses (`?queueFail=1` reports `session_busy`), and the sentence stays exactly where it was — still readable, still editable. The panel swaps its hint for `重试`, and the row is opened into a field in the same frame: a state that must not be retried on its own, and must not look the same as one still waiting.
